$comment: Single source of truth for the Checkbox API (and the shared .vin-choice layout). Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Turn an option on or off, alone or in a group.
thumb: Email updatesSMS alerts

label.description: Visible label, linked to the checkbox. Without it, pass an aria-label.

description.description: Smaller text under the label, read out with the checkbox.

controlPosition.description: Put the checkbox after the text, full width.

indeterminate.description: The "some selected" dash. In HTML, set input.indeterminate = true with a line of JavaScript.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A real checkbox input with its label. Clicking the label toggles it.

examples.title: With a description
examples.description: Extra text under the label is linked with aria-describedby, so it is read out with the checkbox.

examples.title: Group
examples.description: Wrap related checkboxes in a fieldset with a legend, so the group has a name.

a11y: A native <input type="checkbox">: Space toggles it, and forms submit it with no extra code.
Every checkbox has a label: a <label for> or an aria-label.
Related checkboxes sit in a <fieldset> with a <legend>.
Visible focus ring in every style and mode; the tick is drawn, not a font icon.
